R955.summary: Gottfried van Swieten at Bonn to Count Cobenzl at Brussels, 1757-58: the magistrate deliberated what to do if the French had to abandon Hanau, dared to advise neutrality and even decided on it, but keeps it a profound secret.
R955.en:
«In a deputation of the Magistrate here they have deliberated on the course to take in case the French should be obliged
to abandon Hanau; some have dared to vote for neutrality and even to conclude it; they» nevertheless keep a deep secret
about it, as is right.

snip.cap: ARA Brussels, SEG 1236 f. 141: the ciphered sentence on Hanau and, below it, the same sentence in clear
snip.credit: Archives générales du Royaume, Brussels, Secrétairerie d’État et de Guerre inv. 1236 f. 141, via DECODE R955

system: Three-digit alphabetical syllabary of 1757 (202-586): letters at the head of their sections, then their syllables, with a few homophones.
